vars.prTitle: satokengen: include the rejection reason in ErrInvalidApiKey
vars.prBody: When a service account token fails to decode we only log `invalid API key`, which makes it hard to tell a truncated token from a checksum mismatch. ErrInvalidApiKey now carries a short Reason (never the token itself) and includes it in Error(). Unwrap is unchanged, so errors.Is(err, apikeygen.ErrInvalidApiKey) keeps working.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "Adding the Reason field makes satokengen.ErrInvalidApiKey a non-zero-size struct, which silently breaks the identity check in pkg/services/serviceaccounts/extsvcaccounts/service.go getExtSvcAccountToken: `errors.Is(err, &satokengen.ErrInvalidApiKey{})` only ever matched because pointers to a zero-size struct all point at the runtime zerobase and compare equal. Now the error returned by Decode (via GetExtSvcCredentials, line 478) and the freshly allocated target are different pointers, ErrInvalidApiKey has no Is method, and Unwrap yields apikeygen.ErrInvalidApiKey which is not the target either, so errors.Is returns false. The \"Invalid token found in store, recovering...\" path is never taken: a corrupted/invalid external service token in the secrets store is returned as a hard error, so the plugin's external service registration fails on every startup instead of the token being regenerated. The check should use errors.As or a sentinel, or ErrInvalidApiKey needs an Is method.", "severity": "High"}]
